components.description: The main body of the AK-47, housing the other components and providing the structural framework for the weapon. It is typically made of steel or other durable materials.
The part of the AK-47 where the bullet is fired from, responsible for directing the projectile towards its target. It is typically made of chrome-lined steel to reduce wear and corrosion.

The component responsible for cycling the action of the AK-47, extracting the spent cartridge and chambering a new round. It works in conjunction with the recoil spring to return the bolt to its forward position.
The component that stores energy as the bolt recoils, then releases it to return the bolt to its forward position, thus cycling the action of the AK-47.
The component responsible for striking the primer to ignite the cartridge, thus firing the AK-47. It includes the hammer and trigger components.
